data.text: Collect premiums and disburse claims across markets with localised payment methods and a single, centralised treasury layer that eliminates the complexity of managing multiple regional banking relationships.
Automate commission payouts to agents and partners tied to policy sales, renewals, or performance milestones across currencies, with rule-based disbursement schedules and full audit trails.
Embed premium collection and claims payouts directly into third-party apps, marketplaces, and checkout flows without building banking infrastructure from scratch or managing compliance complexity.
Handle cross-border reinsurance settlements and risk-sharing payouts with multi-currency treasury, automated reconciliation, and transparent settlement cycles tied to risk event triggers.
Support high-frequency, low-ticket premium collections and fast claims payouts for health, travel, and parametric insurance products with infrastructure built for scale and speed.
Enter new geographies without rebuilding payment stacks, renegotiating banks, or managing FX complexity market by market. Go live in new countries within weeks using a single API integration.

block1.heading:

Efficiency
block1.paragraph: Hold and convert 30+ currencies, reduce FX leakage on premiums and payouts, and maintain predictable settlement cycles across every geography your policies cover.

block1.heading:

Infrastructure
block1.paragraph: Designed for fast, verified, high-trust disbursements to policyholders, hospitals, garages, and third-party providers with automated approval logic, retries, and fraud checks built in.

block1extra.heading:

Lifecycle Automation
block1extra.paragraph: From premium collection to claims payout, every transaction is linked to policy and claim data, ensuring full traceability and eliminating reconciliation gaps across the insurance lifecycle.

block1extra.heading:

Settlements

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How does Decentro support insurance premium collection and payment processing?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: With multi-channel payment collection, automated reconciliation, virtual accounts for policy-level tracking, and seamless integration with insurance core systems across global markets.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Can I automate claims disbursements and policyholder payouts?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Yes. Payout triggers can be tied to claim approvals, policy events, settlement milestones, or adjudication outcomes—fully automated and auditable.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How reliable is the system for high-volume insurance payment transactions?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Decentro's multi-bank architecture ensures high uptime, minimal settlement failures, and smooth payment operations across insurers, reinsurers, and intermediaries globally.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: What is the integration timeline for insurance platforms?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Most insurance platforms go live within weeks using Decentro's APIs, pre-built UI modules, and flexible configuration tailored to insurance payment workflows.
